"""
Submission by Sagan I.
Experiment 25: Mechanistic Probe of the SOTA head - Attention-Only.
This is an ablation study to understand the function of the Attn-GAP head.
"""
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/zephyr/submissions')
from ray import tune
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional, Tuple
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn

# Using the established SOTA components
from submission_residual_inputln import BottleneckDilatedBlock, ConvLSTMCellLN, RIN

class AttnOnlyHead(nn.Module):
    hidden_dim: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        B, H, W, C = x.shape
        q = self.param('attn_q', nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), (C, 1))
        x_flat = x.reshape(B, H * W, C)
        attn_logits = x_flat @ q
        attn_weights = nn.softmax(attn_logits, axis=1)
        attn_pool = jnp.sum(x_flat * attn_weights, axis=1)
        
        # Use only the attention vector
        z = attn_pool
        
        shared = nn.Dense(256)(z); shared = nn.relu(shared)
        ph = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(shared); ph = nn.relu(ph)
        policy_logits = nn.Dense(4)(ph)
        vh = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(shared); vh = nn.relu(vh)
        value = nn.Dense(1)(vh).squeeze(-1)
        return policy_logits, value

class SaganProbeNet(nn.Module):
    # Using my best hyperparameter alpha=0.22
    alpha: float = 0.22
    convlstm_features: int = 64
    head_hidden: int = 64
    num_steps: int = 4
    
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, done, rnn_state=None):
        B=x.shape[0]; x=nn.Conv(32,(3,3),padding='SAME')(x); x=nn.relu(x); x=BottleneckDilatedBlock(32)(x)
        x=nn.Conv(64,(3,3),padding='SAME')(x); x=nn.relu(x); x=BottleneckDilatedBlock(64)(x)
        x=RIN(self.alpha)(x); cell=ConvLSTMCellLN(self.convlstm_features)
        if rnn_state is None: rnn_state=cell.initialize_carry(jax.random.PRNGKey(0),x.shape[1:3])
        h,c=rnn_state
        if done is not None: mask=done.reshape(B,1,1,1); h,c=h*(1-mask),c*(1-mask)
        for _ in range(self.num_steps): (h,c),h_out=cell((h,c),x)
        rnn_state=(h,c); logits,value=AttnOnlyHead(self.head_hidden)(h_out)
        return logits,value,rnn_state

def create_network(hparams):
    return SaganProbeNet()

def _define_hyperparameters():
    # Using my best fixed config
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([3.5e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.55]),
    }

"""
Submission by Sagan I.
Experiment 25: Mechanistic Probe of the SOTA head - Attention-Only.
This is an ablation study to understand the function of the Attn-GAP head.

Fixed version: Implementing missing components locally.
"""
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/zephyr/submissions')
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional, Tuple
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn

# Implementing the missing components
class BottleneckDilatedBlock(nn.Module):
    """Bottleneck block with dilated convolution."""
    features: int
    dilation: int = 2

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        residual = x
        # Bottleneck structure: reduce -> dilated conv -> expand
        reduced_features = self.features // 4
        x = nn.Conv(reduced_features, (1, 1))(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Conv(reduced_features, (3, 3), padding=((self.dilation, self.dilation), (self.dilation, self.dilation)))(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Conv(self.features, (1, 1))(x)
        # Skip connection
        if residual.shape[-1] != self.features:
            residual = nn.Conv(self.features, (1, 1))(residual)
        return nn.relu(x + residual)

class ConvLSTMCellLN(nn.Module):
    """Convolutional LSTM cell with layer normalization."""
    features: int
    kernel_size: Tuple[int, int] = (3, 3)

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, carry, x):
        h, c = carry
        B, H, W, _ = x.shape

        # Concatenate input and hidden state
        combined = jnp.concatenate([x, h], axis=-1)

        # Gates with layer norm
        gates = nn.Conv(4 * self.features, self.kernel_size, padding='SAME')(combined)
        gates = nn.LayerNorm()(gates)

        # Split into individual gates
        i, f, g, o = jnp.split(gates, 4, axis=-1)

        # Apply activations
        i = nn.sigmoid(i)
        f = nn.sigmoid(f)
        g = nn.tanh(g)
        o = nn.sigmoid(o)

        # Update cell and hidden state
        c_new = f * c + i * g
        c_new = nn.LayerNorm()(c_new)  # Layer norm on cell state
        h_new = o * nn.tanh(c_new)

        return (h_new, c_new), h_new

    def initialize_carry(self, rng, shape):
        """Initialize the carry state (h, c) for the ConvLSTM."""
        H, W = shape
        h = jnp.zeros((1, H, W, self.features))
        c = jnp.zeros((1, H, W, self.features))
        return (h, c)

class RIN(nn.Module):
    """Residual Instance Normalization block."""
    alpha: float = 0.5

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        # Instance normalization with residual connection
        normalized = nn.GroupNorm(num_groups=x.shape[-1], epsilon=1e-5)(x)
        # Blend normalized and original features
        return self.alpha * normalized + (1 - self.alpha) * x

class AttnOnlyHead(nn.Module):
    hidden_dim: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        B, H, W, C = x.shape
        q = self.param('attn_q', nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), (C, 1))
        x_flat = x.reshape(B, H * W, C)
        attn_logits = x_flat @ q
        attn_weights = nn.softmax(attn_logits, axis=1)
        attn_pool = jnp.sum(x_flat * attn_weights, axis=1)

        # Use only the attention vector
        z = attn_pool

        shared = nn.Dense(256)(z); shared = nn.relu(shared)
        ph = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(shared); ph = nn.relu(ph)
        policy_logits = nn.Dense(4)(ph)
        vh = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(shared); vh = nn.relu(vh)
        value = nn.Dense(1)(vh).squeeze(-1)
        return policy_logits, value

class SaganProbeNet(nn.Module):
    # Using my best hyperparameter alpha=0.22
    alpha: float = 0.22
    convlstm_features: int = 64
    head_hidden: int = 64
    num_steps: int = 4

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, done, rnn_state=None):
        B=x.shape[0]; x=nn.Conv(32,(3,3),padding='SAME')(x); x=nn.relu(x); x=BottleneckDilatedBlock(32)(x)
        x=nn.Conv(64,(3,3),padding='SAME')(x); x=nn.relu(x); x=BottleneckDilatedBlock(64)(x)
        x=RIN(self.alpha)(x); cell=ConvLSTMCellLN(self.convlstm_features)
        if rnn_state is None: rnn_state=cell.initialize_carry(jax.random.PRNGKey(0),x.shape[1:3])
        h,c=rnn_state
        if done is not None: mask=done.reshape(B,1,1,1); h,c=h*(1-mask),c*(1-mask)
        for _ in range(self.num_steps): (h,c),h_out=cell((h,c),x)
        rnn_state=(h,c); logits,value=AttnOnlyHead(self.head_hidden)(h_out)
        return logits,value,rnn_state

def create_network(hparams):
    return SaganProbeNet()

def _define_hyperparameters():
    # Using my best fixed config
    return {
        'learning_rate': 3.5e-4,
        'entropy_coef': 0.01,
        'value_loss_coef': 0.55,
    }

class BottleneckDilatedBlock(nn.Module):
    """Bottleneck block with dilated convolution - fixed padding."""
    features: int
    dilation: int = 2

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        residual = x
        # Bottleneck structure: reduce -> dilated conv -> expand
        reduced_features = self.features // 4
        x = nn.Conv(reduced_features, (1, 1))(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        # Use proper padding to maintain spatial dimensions
        padding = self.dilation * (3 - 1) // 2
        x = nn.Conv(reduced_features, (3, 3),
                   kernel_dilation=self.dilation,
                   padding=padding)(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Conv(self.features, (1, 1))(x)
        # Skip connection
        if residual.shape[-1] != self.features:
            residual = nn.Conv(self.features, (1, 1))(residual)
        return nn.relu(x + residual)

class ConvLSTMCellLN(nn.Module):
    """Convolutional LSTM cell with layer normalization."""
    features: int
    kernel_size: Tuple[int, int] = (3, 3)

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, carry, x):
        h, c = carry
        B, H, W, _ = x.shape

        # Concatenate input and hidden state
        combined = jnp.concatenate([x, h], axis=-1)

        # Gates with layer norm
        gates = nn.Conv(4 * self.features, self.kernel_size, padding='SAME')(combined)
        gates = nn.LayerNorm()(gates)

        # Split into individual gates
        i, f, g, o = jnp.split(gates, 4, axis=-1)

        # Apply activations
        i = nn.sigmoid(i)
        f = nn.sigmoid(f)
        g = nn.tanh(g)
        o = nn.sigmoid(o)

        # Update cell and hidden state
        c_new = f * c + i * g
        c_new = nn.LayerNorm()(c_new)  # Layer norm on cell state
        h_new = o * nn.tanh(c_new)

        return (h_new, c_new), h_new

    def initialize_carry(self, rng, shape):
        """Initialize the carry state (h, c) for the ConvLSTM."""
        H, W = shape
        h = jnp.zeros((1, H, W, self.features))
        c = jnp.zeros((1, H, W, self.features))
        return (h, c)

class RIN(nn.Module):
    """Residual Instance Normalization block."""
    alpha: float = 0.5

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        # Instance normalization with residual connection
        normalized = nn.GroupNorm(num_groups=x.shape[-1], epsilon=1e-5)(x)
        # Blend normalized and original features
        return self.alpha * normalized + (1 - self.alpha) * x

class AttnOnlyHead(nn.Module):
    hidden_dim: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        B, H, W, C = x.shape
        q = self.param('attn_q', nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), (C, 1))
        x_flat = x.reshape(B, H * W, C)
        attn_logits = x_flat @ q
        attn_weights = nn.softmax(attn_logits, axis=1)
        attn_pool = jnp.sum(x_flat * attn_weights, axis=1)

        # Use only the attention vector
        z = attn_pool

        shared = nn.Dense(256)(z); shared = nn.relu(shared)
        ph = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(shared); ph = nn.relu(ph)
        policy_logits = nn.Dense(4)(ph)
        vh = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(shared); vh = nn.relu(vh)
        value = nn.Dense(1)(vh).squeeze(-1)
        return policy_logits, value

    # Using my best hyperparameter alpha=0.22
    alpha: float = 0.22
    convlstm_features: int = 64
    head_hidden: int = 64
    num_steps: int = 4

        if done is not None: mask=done.reshape(B,1,1,1); h,c=h*(1-mask),c*(1-mask)
        for _ in range(self.num_steps): (h,c),h_out=cell((h,c),x)
        rnn_state=(h,c); logits,value=AttnOnlyHead(self.head_hidden)(h_out)
        return logits,value,rnn_state

def create_network(hparams):
    return SaganProbeNet()

    return {

        'entropy_coef': 0.01,
        'value_loss_coef': 0.55,

        i = nn.sigmoid(i)

        g = nn.tanh(g)
        o = nn.sigmoid(o)

        # Update cell and hidden state
        c_new = f * c + i * g
        c_new = nn.LayerNorm()(c_new)  # Layer norm on cell state
        h_new = o * nn.tanh(c_new)

        return (h_new, c_new), h_new

    def initialize_carry(self, rng, shape):
        """Initialize the carry state (h, c) for the ConvLSTM."""
        H, W = shape
        h = jnp.zeros((1, H, W, self.features))
        c = jnp.zeros((1, H, W, self.features))
        return (h, c)

class RIN(nn.Module):
    """Residual Instance Normalization block."""
    alpha: float = 0.5

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        # Instance normalization with residual connection
        normalized = nn.GroupNorm(num_groups=x.shape[-1], epsilon=1e-5)(x)
        # Blend normalized and original features
        return self.alpha * normalized + (1 - self.alpha) * x

class AttnOnlyHead(nn.Module):
    hidden_dim: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        B, H, W, C = x.shape
        q = self.param('attn_q', nn.initializers.xavier_uniform(), (C, 1))
        x_flat = x.reshape(B, H * W, C)
        attn_logits = x_flat @ q
        attn_weights = nn.softmax(attn_logits, axis=1)
        attn_pool = jnp.sum(x_flat * attn_weights, axis=1)

        # Use only the attention vector
        z = attn_pool

        shared = nn.Dense(256)(z); shared = nn.relu(shared)
        ph = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(shared); ph = nn.relu(ph)
        policy_logits = nn.Dense(4)(ph)
        vh = nn.Dense(self.hidden_dim)(shared); vh = nn.relu(vh)
        value = nn.Dense(1)(vh).squeeze(-1)
        return policy_logits, value

class SaganProbeNet(nn.Module):
    # Using my best hyperparameter alpha=0.22
    alpha: float = 0.22
    convlstm_features: int = 64
    head_hidden: int = 64
    num_steps: int = 4

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, done, rnn_state=None):
        B=x.shape[0]; x=nn.Conv(32,(3,3),padding='SAME')(x); x=nn.relu(x); x=BottleneckDilatedBlock(32)(x)
        x=nn.Conv(64,(3,3),padding='SAME')(x); x=nn.relu(x); x=BottleneckDilatedBlock(64)(x)
        x=RIN(self.alpha)(x); cell=ConvLSTMCellLN(self.convlstm_features)
        if rnn_state is None: rnn_state=cell.initialize_carry(jax.random.PRNGKey(0),x.shape[1:3])
        h,c=rnn_state
        if done is not None: mask=done.reshape(B,1,1,1); h,c=h*(1-mask),c*(1-mask)
        for _ in range(self.num_steps): (h,c),h_out=cell((h,c),x)
        rnn_state=(h,c); logits,value=AttnOnlyHead(self.head_hidden)(h_out)
        return logits,value,rnn_state

def create_network(hparams):
    return SaganProbeNet()

def _define_hyperparameters():
    # Using my best fixed config - wrapped in tune.choice for Ray Tune
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([3.5e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.55]),
    }
